questions.question: True or False: Brighton & Hove Albion ended Arsenal's unbeaten start to the 2026–27 Premier League season with a 3–0 victory at the American Express Stadium in September 2026.
questions.anchorClues: Goals from Pascal Groß, Charalampos Kostoulas, and Diego Andrés sealed a memorable 3–0 home win for Brighton over defending champions Arsenal on 19 September 2026.

questions.question: During Manchester City's 5–3 victory over Sunderland in September 2026, which Sunderland forward scored a hat-trick in the defeat?
questions.anchorClues: Brian Brobbey scored all three of Sunderland's goals in their 5–3 loss to Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium on 20 September 2026.

questions.question: A Premier League record was established for the 2026–27 campaign when how many clubs started the season under a new permanent manager?
questions.anchorClues: Nine Premier League clubs started the 2026–27 season under new permanent head coaches, breaking the previous record of eight set in 2016–17.

questions.question: Who holds the record for the most direct corner kick goals scored in Premier League history, netting three 'Olympico' goals directly from the corner flag?
questions.anchorClues: Former Bournemouth winger Junior Stanislas scored three goals directly from corner kicks during his Premier League career, more than any other player in competition history.

questions.question: In September 2014, Leicester City famously defeated Manchester United 5–3 at King Power Stadium. Which Leicester player won two penalties, assisted two goals, and scored one in that comeback?
questions.anchorClues: Jamie Vardy delivered an iconic performance by scoring once, winning two penalties, and providing two assists in Leicester's historic 5–3 win over Manchester United.

questions.question: Which club holds the record for drawing the most consecutive matches in a single 38-match Premier League season, recording 7 straight draws in late 2008?
questions.anchorClues: Manchester City drew seven consecutive Premier League fixtures between October and December 2008 under Mark Hughes.

questions.question: Who was the first South American player to reach 50 career goals in Premier League history?
questions.anchorClues: Uruguayan midfielder Gustavo Poyet reached 50 Premier League goals across his spells with Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur, achieving the mark before Carlos Tevez or Sergio Agüero.

questions.question: Which goalkeeper holds the all-time Premier League record for providing the most direct assists in competition history, setting up 4 goals?
questions.anchorClues: Paul Robinson registered four Premier League assists during his career across spells with Leeds United, Tottenham Hotspur, and Blackburn Rovers.

questions.question: In May 2005, West Bromwich Albion became the first team in Premier League history to escape relegation after being bottom on Christmas Day. Who was their manager?
questions.anchorClues: Bryan Robson orchestrated West Brom's famous 'Great Escape' on the final day of the 2004–05 season with a 2–0 victory over Portsmouth.

questions.question: Which player holds the Premier League record for scoring the most substitute goals in a single calendar month, netting 5 goals off the bench in January 2013?
questions.anchorClues: Adam Le Fondre scored 5 goals as a substitute for Reading in January 2013 alone, winning the Premier League Player of the Month award in the process.
